steps.en: After permission review, copy the skill into your existing agent
steps.zh: 核许可后，将技能复制到已有智能体

steps.en: Supply material and choose a card size
Ask the model to produce an outline with figures and page planning
steps.zh: 要求模型先出含数字与分页规划的大纲

steps.en: Check the extracted figures and confirm the outline
steps.zh: 核对提取的数字，确认大纲

steps.en: Ask the model to fill one HTML file using the supplied template
steps.zh: 要求模型用所给模板填写一个 HTML 文件

steps.en: Inspect the rendered cards and capture the approved result
steps.zh: 查看卡片渲染，截取审核后的结果

value.en: Content is reviewed before poster layout; the model's output still needs visual checks
value.zh: 先审内容再排海报，模型输出仍要目检
